messages:
omar.marketing: Quick launch ask 30 need a small creative set for the benchmark post + webinar. Deliverables: 1 long hero (1200x628), 1 square tile (800x800), 1 schematic SVG (latency vs cost with 3 callouts), and 2 email header sizes. 48hr turnaround if possible.

violet.design: We can take it if scoped tight. Confirming sizes and exports: SVG for schematic (vectors only), PNG@2x for tiles, and Figma components using brand tokens. Any priority?

sam.pm: Priority order: 1) schematic SVG (blog + webinar slide), 2) long hero, 3) square tile, 4) email headers. Schematic should call out batching, KV cache, quantization with small icons and a simple legend. Keep it readable at 800px wide.

lee.content: Copy ready. Two headline options in figma comments: "Serve smarter: cost and latency tradeoffs" and "Inference optimized for scale." I'll add alt text drafts for each asset. Avoid superlatives per legal.

omar.marketing: Also need a logo-free variant for partner syndication and a dark-mode hero for social ads. Please include a one-paragraph usage note.

violet.design: Noted. Will include logo-free and no-copy variants plus dark-mode. Exports: SVG (schematic), PNG@2x (tiles), and optimized PNGs for email headers.

legal-bot: Heads-up: the phrase "Redwood Serving" is trademarked; avoid using it without approval. Also don't state pricing claims. Recommend neutral language fallback.

violet.design: Got it. We'll stick to neutral headlines and include fallback copy in Figma comments. Timeline: wireframes in 16h, first comps in 32h, final assets in 48h. I'll tag reviewers when ready.

figma-bot: File created by violet.design  7 frames added  comments enabled.

omar.marketing: Thanks. If legal requests copy changes, we can use: "Optimized inference for predictable latency and cost."

lee.content: Perfect. I'll sync the alt text to the CMS once assets are exported. Please drop 1 alt-text line per image in Figma.

violet.design: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) schematic SVG + webinar PNG, 2) long hero (light/dark) + square tile, 3) email headers, 4) logo-free/no-copy variants, 5) PNG@2x + optimized SVGs, 6) one-paragraph usage note. Will update thread when frames are uploaded.

omar.marketing: Great, scheduling a 20-min review slot after comps. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

figma-bot: Comment added by lee.content on frame "schematic-v1"  "alt text + short caption here".
